name: Celestial Ruin March
introDiscord: Ancient Fallen Star Walkers patrol ruined celestial roads in perfect formation. Shizuki's old trail notes refer to one particularly decorated Walker as 'Grand Marshal Stompy.'
introTwitch: Ancient Fallen Star Walkers patrol ruined celestial roads in perfect formation. Shizuki's old trail notes refer to one particularly decorated Walker as 'Grand Marshal Stompy.'

celestial-ruin-march-approach.prompt: Three ruined roads cross the marching route.

left.message:
A Berry sits beneath a tiny handmade medal.

"Awarded to Grand Marshal Stompy for Most Dramatic Walking."

right.message: A star-chart coffer rests beneath a collapsed arch.

forward.message: A Fallen Star Walker turns toward you with impeccable military posture.

celestial-ruin-march-depths.prompt: Three roads pass between rows of marching constructs.

left.message: A Walker breaks formation to intercept you.

right.message: Shizuki's tonic reads: "Grand Marshal Stompy remains undefeated in staring contest. I suspect cheating."
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the tonic and avoid challenging military leadership.

forward.message: A meteor-iron reliquary rests beneath an old celestial banner.

celestial-ruin-march-threshold.prompt: The Temple of the Fallen Arc rises beyond three ceremonial approaches.

left.message: Star Candies lie beneath a fallen monument.

right.message: A Walker blocks the approach with extraordinary seriousness.

forward.message: Shizuki's bottle reads: "Official diplomatic supplies. Diplomacy failed."
forward.fullHpMessage:
"You leave the failed diplomatic supplies untouched."

BOSS:

bossPromptDiscord:
The marching stops.

Every Walker turns toward the Temple.

A much larger figure steps forward.

Use /yes to enter the Temple of the Fallen Arc or /no to avoid a formal audience with extremely heavy footsteps.
bossPromptTwitch:
The marching stops.

Every Walker turns toward the Temple.

A much larger figure steps forward.

Use !yes to enter the Temple of the Fallen Arc or !no to avoid a formal audience with extremely heavy footsteps.
bossRetreatText:
You retreat.

The march resumes with perfect discipline.

boss.revealText:
A towering celestial construct raises its weapon.

Firmament Warden reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Warden falls silent.

The smaller Walkers return to their endless march.

Grand Marshal Stompy's identity remains classified."
